authority: §157 and clarification 1, 50edac15; user confirms source next token

fenced_code.definition: Inside a fenced code block versus in prose; frozen source has at least 40 tokens before closing.

latex_list.definition: Inside a LaTeX list environment versus outside; frozen source has at least 40 tokens before closing.

number_completion.definition: Next authored-source token completes the number/date already begun versus no number/date begun at the read position.

word_first_piece.definition: Read token is the first piece of a multi-token source word versus a complete word.
